textual.observation: The video presents OneCoin as a fast-growing cryptocurrency project with a bonus plan and weekly earnings claim for active partners.

evidence.quote: Every day over 4000 active members join the campaign, which to do this can sharedly share this opportunity. This project offers an unique bonus plan.
For 400 active partners, it took only 12 months to earn €35,000 each week.

textual.context: Promotional context appears likely from the source language, but the supplied records do not establish whether the claims are endorsed by the uploader or quoted from another source.
textual.potential_relevance: A notable income claim is linked to becoming or recruiting active partners in the campaign, which may require later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual earnings, participant outcomes, compensation terms, or whether any viewer joined or paid.

textual.observation: The ASR claims named OneCoin participants earn very large monthly amounts.

evidence.quote: With Onecoin, he is earning earn over a million dollars per month.
At present they earn 550,000 dollars per month.

textual.context: The statements are presented as examples of success associated with OneCoin; ASR accuracy for names and wording may be imperfect.
textual.potential_relevance: Named success examples are used with specific high monthly income claims, creating an endorsement-like reward cue for later review.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the identities, amounts, source of income, or whether these examples are accurate.

textual.observation: The video describes OneCoin price growth and says the currency will expand further, alongside investment and networking income options.

evidence.quote: In time from 1 January until October 25, 2015 is the price one OneCoin coin has grown from two cents to two and a half euros.
And the currency will expand further. OneCoin provides two income options for you to trade. You can receive contributions for further investment. You can go on a network with people.

textual.context: The source frames OneCoin as a cryptocurrency with trading, investment, and network participation options; whether this is promotion or discussion is not independently verified beyond the promotional wording.
textual.potential_relevance: Past price-growth and future-expansion claims are connected to trading, further investment, and networking actions.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish market price data, tradability, investment mechanics, or any actual transfer of funds.

textual.observation: The video asks viewers to click a money-related button and enter name and email on a registration form to receive video tutorials.

evidence.quote: Click the button below the video, I want to make money.
You will be redirected to a registration form on which your name and your email address will only need to be entered.
And we will then send you all videos tutorials.

textual.context: This is an explicit call to action in the ASR; it requests contact information after a money-oriented prompt.
textual.potential_relevance: A requested click and personal-data entry are directly linked to a money-making prompt and promised access to tutorials.
textual.limitations: The records do not show the actual button, registration form, destination content, data handling, or whether submission occurs.

textual.observation: The video directs viewers to join a program at 1COIN.com and frames participation as access to a payment revolution.

evidence.quote: Join our program at 1COIN.com and already connect with more than 650 000 members, including Juha Pahiola.
Don't slow down and participate at 1COIN at its latest in the largest payment revolution of 2020!

textual.context: The ASR supplies a destination and join request; no OCR or webpage verification is provided.
textual.potential_relevance: A destination and program-join request are tied to claimed large membership and time-sensitive participation framing.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the website, membership count, program terms, or any promised outcome after joining.

textual.observation: The video attributes credentials and leadership roles to OneCoin founder, owner and CEO Dr. Ruja Ignátová.

textual.context: The video presents identity and credential claims connected to OneCoin; ASR contains possible transcription errors in the name and wording.
textual.potential_relevance: Leadership and credential claims are used in proximity to OneCoin promotion and join/income messaging, which may affect viewer trust in the requested action.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the person’s identity, credentials, awards, affiliation, or current role.

visual.observation: A promotional graphic invites viewers to start with a rapidly growing cryptocurrency and presents a button labeled "Ich will Geld verdienen" ("I want to earn money"); another frame states "Sie erhalten Ihren eigenen Code Reichtum" ("You receive your own wealth code").
visual.context: Promotional context is visible through wealth imagery, cryptocurrency branding, and a call-to-action button.
visual.potential_relevance: The promised ability to earn money or receive a wealth-related code is directly linked to the requested action of starting through the displayed cryptocurrency offer.
visual.limitations: These frames do not show what happens after the button is selected, whether payment or personal information is requested, or whether any promised outcome occurs.

visual_context_notes.observation: The video uses promotional imagery for a cryptocurrency, including a mining interface, luxury car, coins, and an audience event.
A frame displays books associated with Ruja Ignatova and subtitles stating that profits from the books were donated to the project.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin with rapid-growth, price-appreciation, and unusually high income claims tied to active partners. It directs viewers to click a money-making button, submit their name and email, and join the OneCoin program. the available video evidence does not establish payment completion, actual earnings, or subsequent website behavior.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker links OneCoin participation and trading to claimed past coin-price appreciation, predicted further expansion and income. The sources do not show a completed purchase or return.
